links.outcome: Readability grade level of burn care patient materials after AI simplification, versus 6th-8th grade target
links.effect: Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, and Meta AI reduced readability scores to within the 6th to 8th-grade level. ChatGPT 4o is not reported as reaching the target. Clinician oversight is still needed for accuracy.
links.quote: Additionally, when tasked with simplifying the texts, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, and Meta AI reduced the readability scores to within the desired 6th to 8th-grade level.

screen.reason: Evaluates prompting/instructing LLMs to simplify patient education materials to target reading levels (6th-8th grade readability constraints).
